platformRelease.note: Option list is filled from the first live export; until then drift on this field is reported as 'unpinned' and fails with --strict only.

gate.note: Project field Gate (ORISO-Docs#211). Absent on the live board until a project admin creates it (see gate-options.json); drift is checked only when it exists.

refactoring.name: refactoring
refactoring.note: Category of a refactoring task (ORISO-Docs#222). ORISO has four native issue types (Task, Bug, Feature, Epic) and no category field on the board, and a board field is never invented, so the category is this repository label on a Task. plan.mjs propose-refactor creates it; the export reads it as items[].refactor.
